```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
library(crosstalk)

datos <- read.csv("./data/resultados_2024.csv",
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

datos_shared <- SharedData$new(datos)
```



```{r tabla, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

bscols(

  widths = c(4,4,4),

  filter_select(
    "finca",
    "Finca",
    datos_shared,
    ~Finca
  ),

  filter_select(
    "lote",
    "Lote",
    datos_shared,
    ~Lote
  )

)


datatable(datos_shared,

  filter = "top",

  extensions = "Buttons",

  rownames = FALSE,

  options = list(

    pageLength = 15,

    scrollX = TRUE,

    autoWidth = TRUE,

    dom = "Bfrtip",

    buttons = c(
      "copy",
      "csv",
      "excel"
    )

  )
)
```
